instruction: I maintain a log of my monthly venmo expense in SimpleNote note. Update it with an entry for this month.
notes: Two apps (venmo, simple_note) plus supervisor. Expense for this month = total of Venmo transactions sent by the supervisor in May 2023, obtained via venmo.show_transactions filtered by direction=sent and created_at within the month (page through results if more than one page; the reference solution's 9 calls likely include a second page or a second search). The note is located by simple_note.search_notes, read with show_note so the existing entry format and month ordering can be preserved, and updated with update_note(content=...) only (title/pinned untouched) so the header remains first and months stay ordered. Static facts (note-matches, content-with-entry, this-month-start/end, sent-direction) encode the task-specific values; supervisor-complete-task takes the note and amount records (non-API params) so its precondition is the lifted goal condition and it must be last.
